future_qualifier_requirements: Require exact schedule, fixture/input identity, metadata/basis, all 1020 native moment slots, 68 contracted slots and expected 17-success/7-rejection classification.
Require all packing_contract_pass flags and two empty_work_and_diagnostics_reset flags. Capture exit intentionally does not itself gate packing or work counts.
Validate certificate/execution counter schemas and current-call relationships; contraction evaluated_rows must equal successful lanes, including zero on empty calls.

Compare every successful original-reference moment using the unchanged dimensional 1e-10 gate. Contraction is mixed rank: use an explicitly documented conservative normalization and compare all four slots to the same linear combination of bound original moments as well as captured moment arithmetic.
Retain exact precision/sign/value differences against singletons as diagnostics, without silently substituting bitwise identity for numerical qualification.
Require successful bounded driver completion and complete saved ledger; API/contraction errors or malformed layouts cannot qualify.
limitations: This is a source review, not Rust type checking or runtime validation. No compiler or evaluator was run.
The new driver does not create numerical acceptance or performance evidence.
Failed controls provide rejection/cleanup coverage only; no numerical array is fabricated for them.
Whole-program public integration and ordinary-default equivalence remain separate pending gates.
reviewed_delta: Public SixPointReductionPlan/SixPointWorkspace aliases replace private entrypoints; no changes to retained fixture decoding, exact input conversion, rank2 Float128/request53 settings or the eleven-call schedule.

Exports child/parent CertificateExecutionStats and requires both to be zero in empty-call reset flags. Stats are Copy and compared using existing PartialEq; immutable workspace borrows do not overlap later mutable calls.

Adds existing public ContractionPlan adapter and ContractionWorkspace with ordered monomials 1,q0,q1,q2*q3 and exact native coefficients 2,-3,1,4. The adapter reuses the parent raw basis and native conventions; no private imported parameter access.

Contraction receives the complete actual BatchResult, including failed neighbors. Every successful contraction exports all four Laurent slots with exact rational, precision and sign representation; statuses and route flags must match the moment result.

One reduction workspace and one contraction workspace are reused across singleton, mixed, reordered, chunked, repeated and empty cases. Each capture records current diagnostics/counters, including contraction evaluated_rows.
Historical singleton moment comparison remains an exact value/precision/sign inventory only. Driver status is capture/status-contract success, never numerical acceptance.
source_api_checks: Both public plan/workspace types and CertificateExecutionStats are exported from lib.rs; signatures used by the driver exist.
Monomial is a public tuple struct with Serialize; coefficient and monomial order matches ContractionPlan input order.
ExecutionStats and CertificateExecutionStats are Copy/PartialEq/Default, so recording fields from the shared stats reference does not move borrowed fields.
Contraction workspace checks full basis, convention, tensor weights, Dual shape, row/component dimensions and buffers before evaluation; it retains input failure statuses and flags.
Numerical prototype is Float128 and exact integer coefficients are converted through from_rational. No f64 round-trip is used for captured values or coefficients.
